blocks.text: The messenger describes being delayed by the “prince of Persia,” helped by Michael, and expecting conflict with the “prince of Greece.” The chapter thus presents the future of Daniel’s people alongside an unseen heavenly conflict. This language concerns the chapter’s angelic world; it should not be extended into demonizing present peoples, assigning a demon to every nation, or treating Daniel’s three weeks of prayer as a technique for controlling angels or explaining every delayed outcome.

sections.title: The princes of Persia and Greece
